title: feat(app-shell): Interfaces pillar — the rail is the app's navigation tree, a kind picker, Design · Run in the item header, a nav-item inspector (objectui#12455)
body:
Fixes #12455
Clause-②: no

No exported signature moves: `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, `studio-canvas-preview.tsx`, `StudioRail.tsx` and `packages/app-shell/package.json` are untouched by this diff (`git diff origin/main...HEAD` on those four paths is empty), and `StudioNavItemInspector` stays out of the package entry.

## What changed

Interfaces pillar, per epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446 decision 5 and the three Interfaces artboards. All work sits in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the `NavTree`, `InterfacesPillar`, `StudioNavItemInspector` regions) and the designer string table.

- **Rail = the app's navigation tree.** `NavTree` now draws each leaf as one 32 px `StudioRailRow`: the entry's icon (its own `icon`, else the object's metadata icon, else the kind glyph), its label, and an uppercase 10 px kind tag (Dashboard, Page, Object, View for an object entry with `viewName`, Report, Link, Action, Component, Doc). Groups are `StudioRailGroup` headers that open as the shipped sidebar (`NavigationRenderer`) opens them: the spec's `expanded`, else open unless 8+ children, always open around the open entry; they collapse from the header. Children are indented 12 px. An empty group reads "No items in this package". Separators stay the decorative `Separator` of objectui#11791. The `type · name` pair stays on the row tooltip (also its accessible description).
- **"+" kind picker.** The rail's add button (`if-create-menu`, kept) opens a 268 px menu listing the ten kinds of `NAV_ENTRY_TYPES` in the spec's order, each with glyph, name and a one-line description. Page / Dashboard / Report keep their test ids (`if-create-page` …) and continue into today's create dialog (objectui#11823). The other seven (`if-add-nav-KIND`) append the entry where "Add nav item" appends one (minted `nav_item_N` id, no label; a group born with `children: []`), open nav editing on it and select it, so the existing nav autosave sends it, and `navPayloadOf` leaves an unbound entry out until it has a target.
- **Item header and tab row.** The tile shows the open entry's icon; the kind chip (`if-canvas-caption`) names the nav kind. Design / Run (`canvas-mode-toggle`) is a 26 px segmented control with pencil / play glyphs, followed by a divider and a properties toggle (`if-properties-toggle`, `aria-pressed`), which is now the one control that collapses the aside in both aside layouts (the aside's own collapse button is gone). Object entries get "Open in Data" (`if-open-in-data`, through the Studio surface channel) and a Preview tab; the runtime-list hint moves from under the canvas to the right of the tab row. Other entries get a Canvas tab.
- **Nav-item inspector.** The aside header reads "Nav item · KIND", the entry label and the nav id. New rows: Icon (the console's `IconPickerWidget`), "Visible when" (the `visible` predicate, read-only), and "Remove nav item".

## Deviations from the artboards

1. **No api chip in the item header or canvas caption.** The artboard shows an api chip; not rendered because `StudioDesignSurface.surfaceIdentity.test.tsx` pins objectui#7254 (label + translated kind on screen, the internal pair on the tooltip). That pin is unmodified and green.
2. **`sharedSelect-11865` pin changes.** Its expected combobox-name lists gain `'Icon'` for every entry kind, because the nav-item inspector now holds the Icon picker. Separately, six nav tests (`navItemInspector`, `navItemInspectorLabel-11196`, `navItemInspectorLabelMaps-11148`, `navItemTypes-11790`, `navPlaceholderSave-11776`, `standardNavEntries-11201`) address the object picker by its existing test id `nav-link-object` instead of "the only combobox"; every `expect(` there keeps its meaning.
3. **Rail rows lose the machine-name second line (objectui#11862).** Rows are one 32 px line, with the machine name on the tooltip, as the card asks ("the id and the bound target stay in the row's title"). `navRailLabels-11862` and `navDraftLabels-11862` now assert the name on `title` / accessible description and absent from the visible text, instead of a mono second line.
4. **Page rows carry a kind tag.** Every leaf now tags its kind, so a page row's accessible name gains "Page". `interfacesRailLabelMap-11158`, `railLabelInherits-11196` and `railSeparatorBadge-11791` query page rows by the new name.
5. **Kind picker items are named by kind, not "New dashboard".** `interfacesCreate-11823` / `interfacesCreatePage-11823` open the create dialog through the kept `if-create-*` test ids; the "controls" case now pins the ten test ids in the spec's order.
6. **Browse-mode inspector stays the leaf's own properties.** The artboards show the nav-item inspector beside a selected page / object entry. Picking a rail row still opens the leaf's own editor (page basics, dashboard widgets, the object's list-view inspector of objectui#11823), as today; the nav-item inspector opens in nav editing and from the "+" picker. Replacing the leaf editor would drop shipped editing surfaces, and the nav autosave is gated on nav editing (objectui#11189, #11167, #11153 pins).
7. **No Source tab for dashboard / report, no "more" button.** No source editor exists for those kinds in Studio (a source page keeps its Source tab in the aside), and the artboard names no action for the more button; an empty affordance would be a fake control.
8. **No rail search and no rail count.** Not in the card's target; the artboard shows them.
9. **Page canvas, object canvas and dashboard canvas are today's.** `PagePreview.tsx` and `DashboardPreview.tsx` are untouched (so objectui's `verify` skill pass is not owed); the page designer already draws dashed region frames with `REGION · size` labels, the object canvas the runtime list in a card, the dashboard the widget grid with the selected ring. Block skeleton cards, the "Design mode" toolbar text and widget padding of the artboards are not restyled here.
10. **Screenshots show a read-only package.** HotCRM's app package is served read-only by `objectstack dev`, so the "+" picker (hidden on read-only packages, objectui#12453's area) is not open in the page screenshot; the picker is pinned in `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesNavTree-12455.test.tsx`.

- New pin `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesNavTree-12455.test.tsx`: 12 tests. Ablation once (three mutations in one run: the View tag, honouring `expanded`, the toggle's `aria-pressed`): exactly the three matching tests went red, 9 stayed green; restored from `HEAD`, blob hash matched.
